scope: DDO154, kept cube K=4, continuum_v001 cylinder K_big=64 or 128, fixed inclination 66 degrees

prelaunch.identity: Exact canonical physical/coefficient/numerics/driver identity; omit label and certificate refs and derived config hash only
prelaunch.EPS: Reviewed producer; TESTED PASS; exact point/custody; sampled and locally maximized cardinal-torus envelope, conservative shell eps; contiguous coverage through ceil(sqrt(2)*K_big); no two refinement failures
prelaunch.GQ: Reviewed producer; TESTED PASS; all production k_perp nodes and all possible GL4 columns; max_i abs(P_i(M_s)-P_i(2*M_s))/analytic_P_i(0), divided by 1-zero_mode_relative_error, <=1e-12; nonnegative element masses required
prelaunch.LO: No anchor promotion. A point LO slot is pending until a point-specific uniform bound or the registered current-state acceptance process is reviewed. A prelaunch verifier pass does not approve a launch or replace the production module's LO slot requirement.

acceptance.inventory: Derive independently from full result/sidecar lineage, never from the certificate manifest. Include every source-influencing route-A mixture and route-B source consumed by the accepted call.
acceptance.LO: Exact state/source match; every shell <=0.005 tau; sum of per-shell maxima <=0.05 tau; exact row contract; source fidelity I1T PASS; contiguous coverage through ceil(sqrt(2)*K_big)
acceptance.GQ: Actual roster positivity and geometry match the prelaunch uniform bound, or stop pending a reviewed source-specific successor rule
acceptance.fail_closed: Missing, stale, malformed, contradictory or incomplete evidence yields pending certificate/NUMERICS_UNCERTIFIED; never a calibration success or a fabricated physical rejection

integration_requirements: Run adapter validate_block before the verifier (K=4 and all production numerics checks remain there)
Approve exact producer hashes independently; a record's asserted TESTED/PASS is insufficient
Bind all proof file byte hashes into point/cache identity and acceptance receipt
Call acceptance verifier before accepting or reusing a cached scientific result
Re-audit cached results when missing this acceptance evidence; do not rewrite old files
Any change of source/grid/background/geometry/config/module/row contract invalidates matching proof scope
No launches under dispatch 0511; Claude2 retains launch ownership
label_convention: TESTED source inspection and synthetic verifier tests are distinct from UNTESTED box-wide scientific certificate validity
